implementation: SDK target buckets AUTO/64/128/256 are part of factory identity and cache namespace and reach TextToSpeechOptions. No text is truncated to a guessed token count.

One incremental stream per SDK reply uses separate interruptible input owner, bounded input/cues/timeline, exact-once finish, cancellation and dual-owner retirement before native destruction. Failed retirement retains stream/task/model lease.
Per-utterance voice changes retain model/task with a separate resident identity; voice selection occurs only while idle.
Original segment/UTF8/pronunciation caption mapping remains intact over the reply; quiet-frame map grows as needed within declared bound.
Silent benchmarks exercise actual factory input mode and retain whole-fixture input hash; unsealed playback does not invent whole-attempt input identity.
Production preference, VoiceSettings screen and factory orchestration expose bucket and input mode; malformed preferences use defaults.

Auto CPU threads consume the shared cached device governor and thermal forecast; explicit benchmark and user settings remain fixed. Optional ADPF sessions target only the app-owned CPU synthesis worker, with measured generate-call duration and bounded presentation deadlines.

Original FP32 and compact INT8 have independent installations and a persisted selection; live settings changes retire the old runtime off main before publishing the replacement store. Initial preference hydration precedes initial store exposure.
Failed model destruction retains the native lease, makes awaitClosed fail, and prevents replacement in that output. Deferred output preserves the closed owner until retirement is confirmed.

Failed native factory preparation also retains its factory and surrounding asset lease while native cleanup remains pending; shutdown always retires executors after component callback unregistration failure. Added direct retirement and bucket complete-input regressions.

Split the benchmark ViewModel coroutine into bounded publication, playback, per-backend, native/SDK and lease-retirement helpers after parent reported the canonical DEX method-size failure. Preserve a single report/energy owner and release ownership in finally even if report finalization fails; sustained thermal stops retain results and stop further backends after cleanup priority.
